description: Binds the React Repo Clinic panel to the Codex Repo Clinic fixture-repair splash demo evidence (DETERMINEX_REPO_CLINIC_FIXTURE_REPAIR_SPLASH_DEMO_LOCK_001) read-only. Adds a read-only Tauri command get_repo_clinic_verified_demo_status, a Python loader at scripts/ide/repo_clinic_verified_demo_status.py, and a React component at frontend/src/components/ide-product-shell/RepoClinicVerifiedDemoStatus.tsx. The loader reads the most recent run_*.json under assurance/evidence/repo_clinic_fixture_repair_splash_demo/ and returns PASSED only if (1) status == REPO_CLINIC_FIXTURE_REPAIR_SPLASH_DEMO_PASSED; (2) source_mutation_authorized / training_eligible / approval_authority_granted / authority.real_user_source_mutation_authorized / authority.broad_claims_granted / top-level real_user_source_mutation_authorized are all NOT True; (3) fixture_mutation_only == True; (4) claim_boundary includes 'Repo Clinic Python fixture repair demo only', 'fixture/demo workspace mutation only', 'not all codebases', 'not all languages', 'not arbitrary repair', and 'training remains false'; (5) no affirmative forbidden broad-claim phrase appears outside verification.blocked_path_demo, evidence.claim_scanner_result, and claim_boundary; (6) verification.repair_verified=True implies baseline_failed=True AND repair_tests_passed=True AND false_fixed_claim_blocked=True. If the evidence file is not present locally, returns AWAITING_EVIDENCE; if status != PASSED returns BLOCKED_MALFORMED; the React component surfaces an 'Awaiting Codex reconciliation' or 'Binding blocked' banner accordingly. The component renders demo title, target workflow, language, issue summary, baseline-failure-captured, repair-verifier-passed, repair-verified-for-fixture-only, false-fixed-claim-blocked, fixture-mutation-only badge, affected files, evidence ref, patch body hash, fixture workspace, claim boundary, blocked-path summary, training-false badge, source-mutation-false badge, Ready-does-NOT-mean-authorized + Real user repo mutation NOT authorized captions. It NEVER surfaces: all codebases / all languages / arbitrary repair / arbitrary production repair / real user repo mutation authorized / training enabled / source_mutation_authorized: true / release_ready: true claims.
purpose: Bind the verified Repo Clinic fixture-repair evidence into the live React Repo Clinic panel.
